title: Fix `H5FD_lock` error when writing to hdf with distributed client
body:
When writing a single HDF with multiple datasets, it is possible to get a concurrency error even when locking is enabled (`lock=True`), if the cluster is using processes. When we have a distributed client with processes, it feels logical that a lock from `multiprocessing` should be used. I don't have enough experience in this area of code, so I may be missing something here.

- [x] Closes https://github.com/dask/dask/issues/9972
- [x] Closes https://github.com/dask/dask/issues/10315
- [x] Tests added / passed
- [x] Passes `pre-commit run --all-files`
